visualCharacteristics: A grey band of white panels, each with an icon, a title and arrow buttons; the first panel is wide with its buttons in two columns and the rest sit side by side as cards.
contentPattern: One row per panel: an icon picture, an h2-h4 title, one or more link paragraphs (buttons) and an optional note paragraph.
usage: Use to group task-oriented links (e.g. claims or inquiries) into icon panels with button links.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for icon-headed panels of button links; pick cards for image cards with body text or link-list for plain link lists.
